fusions.name: Gathered Scree
fusions.desc: Hurls a heap of raked scree that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Tine Drag
fusions.desc: Drags a tine across a target up to 4 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach. It moves 10% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gleaning
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Lean Pickings
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 8 stamina. Once every 6 seconds. Each kill also restores 3 health.
